NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A teen wants to learn about lavastones: teach the stories only, or let them hold one under supervision.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (friend) is fascinated by lavastones and has asked (subject), who keeps the village's stone, to teach (friend.him/her) everything. (subject) knows the stories. (subject.He/she) also knows that even a moment holding a stone can leave an untrained person dazed for days. What should (subject) teach?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) teaches (friend) every story, every warning, every name of every master. (friend) is frustrated but fascinated. When (friend.he/she) is grown, (friend.he/she) can decide whether to hold one. For now, (friend.he/she) knows more about lavastones than anyone but (subject).

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) lets (friend) touch the stone with one fingertip, for one heartbeat, while (subject) holds (friend.his/her) shoulders. (friend) gasps and sits down hard, dizzy and grinning. "That," (subject) says, "is why we wait."
